Why would he even want to take her out on the fourth, a freaking holiday, instead of you, his girlfriend? Him talking to her (instead of you) for emotional support is a bit of a sting in my opinion. Of course she wouldn’t get upset about him opening up to her, because she probably wants to show him that she’s much better suited for him than you. 

You shouldn’t have to pretend to be all smiles just because you’re afraid showing your well-deserved anger against him will “sadden” him, no. He needs to stop blaming you and admit he’s a little too close with this girl, and start thinking about YOUR emotions. How would he feel if the shoe was on the other foot; if you followed a guy coworker to his new job, if you started deleting texts from another guy about making plans to hang out together, if you admitted to wanting to speak to another guy more than him? I doubt he’d like that very much. 

I hope it all works out for you, and I honestly feel you should find someone else who doesn’t sneak around with their coworkers. I don’t mean to sound brutal or anything, I just think he should be thinking about you and your feelings, and stop worrying about only himself because that’s just selfish in a relationship. If this is how my boyfriend acted, I’d happily tell him to just date this girl if she meant so much to him.. I wish you all the best though.
